messages:
amanda: Morning async — quick standup. TL;DR: pushing NovaHealth pilot to next week, KMS question from customer.

What I did: demo with Nova, sent SOC2 + SOC3 docs, sprint notes to customer.
Blockers: KMS BYOK timing, HSM compatibility, dedicated infra sizing.
Today: follow up with eng/security on HSM support, update pricing estimate. Ping @josh for dedicated pilot sizing.

josh: Saw the demo notes. Can we reuse the Kestrel config? KMS BYOK will need key-wrap flow — need sec input. I'll check infra capacity for next week.

elaine: Flagged MacroHealth's ask — they want FIPS 140-2 + customer-managed HSM. We have a README but need timeline. @security-bot any update on supported HSM vendors?

security-bot: Quick note: current Private build supports AWS CloudHSM and Azure Key Vault. HSM BYOK roadmap: Luna prototype planned, ETA 2026-04-15. FIPS hardening work in progress; filing SEC ticket.

mike: Pricing estimate updated in the sheet: https://tiny.redwood/pricing-nova. For Dedicated pilot I suggest baseline 4x A10s or 2x A100s with reserved throughput. @amanda — which SLA tier are they asking for?

amanda: They asked for 99.9% uptime and ~100ms p99 on embeddings. If not possible, fallback to 99.5 is acceptable. Also requested audit log retention = 12 months.

sarah: Quick ops note — CR #4321 waiting for review (model-routing fallback). Pinged @josh for code review, ETA today.

josh: Will review CR after infra check. Also need config snippet from eng-run to enable KV cache warmup — can someone paste the minimal snippet?

mike: Snippet:
```json
{
  "cache": { "enabled": true, "warmup_prefixes": ["/pilot/nova"] }
}
```

elaine: MacroHealth also requires EU-only data residency. Need Private deployment in eu-west-1. @mike any net/cert constraints?

mike: We can provision VPC-private in eu-west-1; lead time ~4 business days for networking + certs.

amanda: Next steps: @josh check BYOK compatibility with Kestrel config; @security-bot confirm HSM vendor options + FIPS ETA; @mike finalize sizing & pricing; @sarah follow up CR; I'll update customer and propose Feb 1 pilot start.

security-bot: Noted — adding MacroHealth to HSM interest list and filing ticket SEC-772 for FIPS clarifications.

sarah: CR updated with minor fixes, ready for review.

josh: Review done, left two small comments. Will merge after fixes.

amanda: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll send update to customer in ~1 hour. Anyone else with blockers?

elaine: None from my side.

mike: None here.
